AT WORDS 26-26: typica 'Dominum' vs the 1922 Mame 'Deminum'; the 1922 Mame spells 'Jesum' where the typica spells 'Iesum' (orthography/accent only); the 1922 Mame prints 'Christum' where the typica prints 'Christum,' (pointing only); the 1922 Mame prints 'tuum' where the typica prints 'tuum:' (pointing only); typica has 'tecum vivit et regnat in unitate.' where the 1922 Mame has nothing at this point. Corroboration: Two independent public-domain witnesses were read for every oration: the Pustet Ratisbon 1862 whole-book text layer and the Tours: Mame 1922 editio quarta iuxta typicam Vaticanam (artifact ia-scan-pdf-9873693a), the latter reconstructed column by column from its page word bounding boxes.
